messages:
cara (Partnerships): Heads-up — Q3 partner ops prep. We need to lock partner tier changes, MDF asks, and marketplace co-sell items before the QBR deck cut. Can folks drop current asks + constraints by EOD Thursday? :calendar:
matt (Sales Ops): noted. I'll pull last quarter's scorecards and ARR motion notes. planning to surface any tier churn and renewals next week.
anika (Marketplace): Marketplace has two listing upgrades queued that want co-marketing credits. Need MDF approval and legal signoff. Can we get a budget estimate? :moneybag:
devon (HW Partners): HW partner team is asking for a pilot offering for our Dedicated stack — they'd like $30k MDF + 4-week priority access. Also need a joint announcement window if pilot goes live.
luis (Finance): FYI — current MDF pool for Q3 is constrained. Rough ballpark we can reallocate up to $60k across partners but need business justification per partner (expected pipeline). Send ROI bullets.
olga (SolutionsEng): For SI integrations, we have 2 SIs hitting professional services milestones. They want co-funding for certification workshops (estimate $10k each). Will include partner enablement metrics.
cara (Partnerships): Summary ask template: 1) Partner name 2) Tier change or MDF amount 3) Expected pipeline (ARR) 4) Joint announcement? yes/no 5) Timeline. Use this thread as staging. I'll compile into the QBR deck.
matt (Sales Ops): Quick note on scorecards — proposing we swap weight from 'leads generated' -> 'closed-sourced ARR' for next tiering cycle. Thoughts?
anika (Marketplace): Agree on shifting weights. Marketplace listings often drive trials that convert later, so closed ARR is a better signal. We should include a 6-month lookback window.
devon (HW Partners): For the hardware pilot request: partner = NimbusEdge, MDF = $30k, expected pipeline = $120k ARR over 12 months, joint announcement desired after pilot validation (tentative 9/15). Pilot requires 4 dedicated slots.
luis (Finance): NimbusEdge ask looks plausible but we need a short risk mitigation note: what happens if pilot fails? Do they repay? Also need a measurable acceptance criteria for pilot success.
olga (SolutionsEng): Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) 5 validated customer workloads on Dedicated with <150ms p95 inference, 2) 2 signed customer letters of intent, 3) integration docs merged.
cara (Partnerships): Perfect. Can NimbusEdge and SI leads provide one-pager using template by Thursday 5pm PT? I'll batch for the Exec QBR review Friday.
partner-bot: Reminder: QBR deck due date = 2028-09-01 17:00 UTC. Attachments accepted via Confluence.
matt (Sales Ops): For tiering, I'll produce a delta report showing which partners move up/down given the new scoring weights. Expect draft Monday.
anika (Marketplace): Marketplace asks: Listing upgrades for CloudMarket A & B. MDF requested = $20k total for creative + co-marketing. Expected uplift = +30% leads month-over-month. I'll add channel metrics.
luis (Finance): Ok lock: allocate provisional $30k to NimbusEdge conditional on a signed pilot SOW and success criteria; $20k provisional for marketplace listings. Leaves $10k contingency. I'll update the finance tracker.
devon (HW Partners): Noted. I'll start SOW draft and ping legal — will share here when done.
cara (Partnerships): Thanks all. Action items: Devon — SOW draft; Anika — marketplace metrics + one-pager; NimbusEdge — one-pager + acceptance criteria; Matt — tier delta report; Luis — update tracker. We'll reconvene Thursday 10am PT to validate asks. :thumbsup:
